categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in enterprise-level big data foundational software development, offering three main product matrices: big data and cloud infrastructure platforms, distributed relational databases, and data development and intelligent analysis tools. It also provides application and solution services tailored to big data storage, processing, governance, and analysis scenarios, along with some third-party software and hardware sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include distributed consistency protocols, distributed computing engines supporting batch, streaming, and analytical modes, distributed transaction processing, big data security and data flow technologies, real-time low-latency computing, large-scale graph storage and analysis, vector database technology, container-based data cloud technologies, SQL compilation and optimization, multi-model unified data processing, and AI-driven data asset management. The company emphasizes cloud-native architectures, container orchestration, multi-tenant resource isolation, and supports heterogeneous hardware including X86 and ARM architectures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of industries including finance, government, energy, healthcare, transportation, telecommunications, and manufacturing. Its products support digital transformation and data infrastructure needs across these sectors, with a strong presence in financial institutions and government agencies.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with significant business in economically developed regions such as East China, North China, South China, Northwest China, Central China, Southwest China, and Northeast China. The company also has subsidiaries in Singapore, Canada, and Hong Kong, though overseas revenue is minimal.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the software supply chain, developing and providing foundational big data software platforms and tools. It also offers technical services and solutions, positioning itself as a core technology provider enabling downstream application development and digital transformation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining technological leadership in big data, AI, and cloud computing through continuous R&D investment. The company focuses on multi-modal, intelligent, agile, and democratized data management platforms, embracing AI-generated content (AIGC) and large model innovations. It aims to enhance product competitiveness, expand market share, and build a comprehensive ecosystem with partners, while supporting national initiatives for data security, privacy computing, and domestic software substitution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through software product sales via perpetual licensing, supplemented by technical services and application solutions charged on a project or man-month basis. Maintenance services are recognized over the service period. The company also sells integrated hardware-software products and derives income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic big data foundational software developer, recognized as a market leader in China’s big data management platform sector. It competes with international database vendors like Oracle, IBM, and Teradata, and domestic cloud and ICT providers. It holds a strong position in private deployment markets and is acknowledged by Gartner and IDC as a top vendor with multiple product certifications and industry awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is in a rapid growth phase with 2023 revenue of approximately RMB 490.8 million, a 31.7% increase year-over-year. Despite growth, it remains unprofitable with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 288.2 million. R&D investment is substantial, accounting for nearly 50% of revenue. The company’s total assets are about RMB 1.79 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 1.44 billion, reflecting ongoing investment in technology and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes autonomous innovation and leading-edge technology in distributed big data platforms, multi-model unified data management, and AI integration. Its products support large-scale, heterogeneous data types with high performance and security, enabling customers to build comprehensive data foundations for digital transformation. Unique offerings include cloud-native vector databases, enterprise vertical large language models, and integrated AI operation platforms, differentiating it in the domestic market and supporting national data security and software independence goals.
